accounting.rationale: Original PDF132 defines the RANK-clause route to DIMENSION. Under8.5.8.1p1 DIMENSION includes a scalar, assumed-rank entity or array; the name does not force positive rank. No no-op attribute classifier is added.
RANK is a clause, with its R829 grammar and R802 attribute-specification route. It is not TARGET, whose actual section is8.5.18.
PENDING canonical8.2/R802 and8.5.8.1 source relations. Clause presence is not a bounds/allocation/association observation or an extra execution.
The composed scalar-int-constant-expr retains the scalar, INTEGER and constant-expression owners; an array expression is not admitted solely because it has one element.

10.1.12p1(6) permits qualifying property inquiries on variables. Variable spelling alone does not make RANK(X0) nonconstant, and RANK of a constructor expression is not a substitute for its required data-object argument.

The upper endpoint is the supported processor maximum. Keep5.4.6's separate rank/corank ceiling and4.2's processor limits. An undocumented guessed maximum or the result of the same declaration under test is not independent qualification.
The role/attribute condition also applies when the clause value is zero; scalar status is not an exemption.
This alternative does not waive the declaration's other type, data-object, DIMENSION or procedure restrictions. A procedure pointer must not be admitted merely by matching the POINTER word.

Original PDF132 separately supplies the specified rank, conditional scalar/deferred/assumed-shape categories and the nonpointer/nonallocatable positive-rank lower bounds. Classification alone does not manufacture another passing test.
The zero branch is scalar, not a zero-sized array or deferred-shape scalar. RANK supplies an observable zero result without inventing an allocation, payload or bounds property.
Both array-category branches require positive rank. C864 still supplies the entity-role premise.
The positive-rank ALLOCATABLE/POINTER branch declares a deferred-shape array under8.5.8.4. PENDING exact allocation/pointer/dummy canonical source relationships, not cloned rank witnesses.

No bounds, shape, allocation or association is established merely by the clause. Unallocated/disassociated properties and valid inquiry exceptions retain8.5.8.4/16.1 ownership; allocated and associated bounds retain their actual mechanisms.

The positive-rank nonpointer nonallocatable entity is an assumed-shape array and, by C864, a dummy data object. Explicit-interface, effective-argument and extent rules retain8.5.8.3/15.4/15.5 ownership.
Every lower bound in this assumed-shape branch is one. Do not impose these bounds on the POINTER/ALLOCATABLE branch or infer hidden declared bounds solely from a zero-extent LBOUND result.
The actual unnumbered example continues on PDF133 before8.5.18 TARGET. Its five declarations are fragments, not a complete conforming main program.
X0 is an explicit-shape rank-three object declared before the inquiry. Its rank is constant independently of its data values.
X1 illustrates a constant specification inquiry and ALLOCATABLE deferred shape. No allocation or initialized payload is shown.
X2 illustrates a positive-rank data pointer. The example establishes no target, association status or usable bounds.
X3's nonpointer nonallocatable positive-rank declaration needs a dummy-data-object context under C864, although the illustrative fragment omits its enclosing procedure.
X4 illustrates rank zero, not a zero-sized array. Its displayed lack of ALLOCATABLE/POINTER still requires a dummy-data-object context.
Do not paste the fragments into an ordinary main program and call X3/X4 valid controls. Meaningful future cases must supply complete interfaces and independently valid role/state premises.

requirements.title: A RANK clause encloses a scalar integer constant expression
requirements.source: 8.5.17 R829, physical PDF132, with the DIMENSION route in p1 and8.2 R802
requirements.definition: The clause consists of RANK and one parenthesized scalar INTEGER constant expression. Eligible property inquiries can be constant even when their data-object arguments are variables. The expression category, nonnegative supported value and declared-entity role remain separate conditions.

pending.literal-form: PENDING complete declarations with RANK(0) and a small positive literal in C864-eligible dummy/ALLOCATABLE/POINTER contexts. Keep required-standard qualification and current processor limits explicit; a free-standing unqualified scalar declaration is not a valid control.
pending.named-constant-form: PENDING a previously defined INTEGER PARAMETER rank value and an otherwise valid RANK clause. Preserve its canonical PARAMETER/constant-expression sources without duplicating those owners.
pending.specification-inquiry-form: PENDING the original RANK(RANK(X0)) route using a prior explicit-shape rank-three data object with constant rank. Do not require its unused payload to be defined or replace X0 by a constructor/fixed expected-rank variable.
pending.expression-category-source-relations: PENDING exact scalar/INTEGER/constant-expression contrasts and their canonical C401/R1032/C1014 relations. A procedure-local specification expression need not be constant; a variable appearing only in an eligible property inquiry can be constant. Isolate the actual violated condition before claiming a diagnostic.
pending.parenthesis-grammar-exclusion: PENDING a complete eligible declaration with a single missing or malformed RANK parenthesis and a one-site valid repair. Calibrate the real grammatical cause and legitimate origin; no unrelated role/range/recovery report or coalesced source is acceptable.

requirements.oracle: Finite syntax controls and minimal repairs, with independently sourced expression-category relationships. All new facets are pending and no existing RANK inquiry case is retagged.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The grammar is not an oracle for processor rank limits, allocation, pointer association, assumed-shape bounds or runtime value. Reporting capability does not prescribe fatal exit, English wording or a printed rule code; unsupported-feature, ICE, echo and wrong-origin reports do not qualify.

requirements.title: The RANK-clause value lies between zero and the supported maximum
requirements.definition: The constant INTEGER value in the clause is nonnegative and does not exceed the processor's supported maximum array rank. Other standard rank/corank and declaration restrictions still apply; an extension or a guessed supported limit is not a portable boundary oracle.

pending.negative-exclusion: PENDING a C864-eligible declaration with the exactly representable constant -1, repaired only to0. Preserve the same role and all syntax; the report must identify the negative rank rather than a parser, type or unrelated shape error.
pending.zero-admission: PENDING a complete eligible RANK(0) declaration. Scalar status does not excuse C864, and zero is not an unknown-rank marker or an empty array.
pending.ordinary-positive-admission: PENDING a small valid positive rank within an independently qualified configuration. Keep5.4.6's rank-plus-corank ceiling and other attributes separate, rather than testing the processor endpoint accidentally.
pending.supported-maximum-boundary: PENDING an independent version/configuration-bound supported-maximum contract and a complete declaration at that endpoint. A recommendation to document limits is not made mandatory, and probing the same clause's acceptance cannot supply its own oracle.
pending.above-supported-maximum-exclusion: PENDING the same independently justified endpoint, a representable endpoint-plus-one expression and a one-site endpoint repair. Do not label16 universally a C863 violation or accept failure due to another standard ceiling, constant overflow, resource limit or missing language support.

requirements.oracle: An unconditional negative-value contrast and processor-qualified finite endpoint contrasts, each with valid entity-role controls and exact report origins.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No maximum-rank profile is presently supplied. Keep this gate pending rather than guessing a limit, deriving it from the case under test or making recommended documentation a new mandatory requirement.

requirements.title: A RANK-clause entity has an eligible dummy role or storage attribute
requirements.definition: An entity declared using the clause is a dummy data object or has ALLOCATABLE or POINTER. The condition includes rank-zero declarations. It does not override other rules about which entities and declaration forms can have these attributes.

pending.ordinary-dummy-admission: PENDING complete scalar RANK(0) and positive-rank ordinary INTEGER dummy declarations, with genuine interfaces wherever required. Their rank and bounds effects remain separate S/canonical owners.
pending.allocatable-admission: PENDING ordinary scalar and array ALLOCATABLE declarations with eligible rank expressions. Compilation does not allocate them or make payload/bounds inquiries valid.
pending.pointer-admission: PENDING ordinary scalar and array data-pointer declarations with eligible rank expressions. No target, defined association or useful bounds follows from admitting the declaration.
pending.ordinary-local-positive-exclusion: PENDING a complete subroutine with a positive-rank ordinary local declaration, repaired only by adding the entity to its dummy list. Avoid conflicting array-spec, initialization or a body reference.
pending.ordinary-local-zero-exclusion: PENDING the otherwise identical RANK(0) local/dummy contrast. The example's scalar branch must not become a false exception to the role constraint.
pending.nondata-role-source-boundary: PENDING complete declaration/source relationships for procedure, component and other entity categories. The POINTER word alone is not proof of eligibility; preserve other grammar/attribute owners and adjudicate any inseparable competing constraint before writing a negative.

requirements.oracle: Complete role/attribute declarations with minimal ordinary-local repairs; all case plans remain pending. Declaration admission is distinct from rank, shape, allocation, association and runtime effect.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The five NOTE declarations are not a self-contained valid program. Do not infer role from a name, skip C864 at rank zero, manufacture unsupported feature diagnostics or promote compile controls into effects.

requirements.title: An eligible RANK-clause declaration has its specified rank
requirements.source: 8.5.17 p2 first sentence and zero-rank branch, physical PDF132
requirements.definition: The eligible entity's rank equals the constant value specified by the clause; value zero denotes a scalar. This is not the dynamic assumed-rank category, a zero-sized positive-rank array, or a claim about available shape and data.

pending.zero-rank-effect: PENDING a real RANK(0) declaration in a valid dummy/ALLOCATABLE/POINTER context and a genuine inquiry observer expecting literal0. Establish presence and any required state without reading undefined data; count the complete call/return/guard path.
pending.positive-rank-effects: PENDING finite rank-one/rank-two declarations using the clause itself, observed through actual named data objects with independent literal1/2 expectations. Do not substitute the existing assumed-rank family, whose actual declarations do not use RANK clauses.
pending.named-constant-rank-effect: PENDING a prior INTEGER named constant specifying the declared rank, with a separately fixed small literal oracle, not a comparison against that same parameter as the sole expected value.
pending.specification-inquiry-rank-effect: PENDING the prior rank-three X0 inquiry route and a real declared entity whose observed rank is checked against literal3. The outer object's RANK inquiry is not to be replaced by reevaluating only the inner specification expression.

requirements.oracle: Independent literal ranks on actual objects, with complete interfaces, required states and counted execution; whole-program wrong-oracle sensitivity is required before an implementation is approved.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No programs or oracles are implemented by this source packet. Rank inquiry does not authorize unavailable payload/shape/bounds access. Existing lexical, C834, assumed-rank and finalization witnesses retain their original owners and roles.

requirements.title: The positive-rank ordinary dummy branch has unit lower bounds
requirements.definition: For positive rank without POINTER or ALLOCATABLE, the RANK clause specifies an assumed-shape array with lower bound one in every dimension. C864 requires the ordinary dummy-data-object role. Deferred-shape declarations, scalar rank zero and effective-argument extents have their own conditions.

pending.rank-one-unit-lower-bound: PENDING an explicit-interface ordinary RANK(1) dummy receiving a defined named array with a nonunit lower bound and positive extent. Inquire the whole actual dummy's LBOUND and expect literal1, not an expression-normalized temporary or the caller's bound.
pending.all-dimension-unit-lower-bounds: PENDING a RANK(2) ordinary dummy receiving a defined array with two independently nonunit lower bounds and positive extents. Expect[1,1] at the actual dummy, with complete per-dimension guards and no pointer/allocatable branch substitution.
pending.empty-inquiry-source-boundary: PENDING canonical LBOUND/zero-extent source and observation relationships. An empty dimension's normalized inquiry result cannot by itself prove a hidden declared bound; retain that observability gate instead of counting a redundant empty-program check as closure.

requirements.oracle: Direct whole-dummy lower-bound observations with independent literals in the positive-extent cases; separately qualified source relationships for empty dimensions.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This packet supplies no execution. Unit lower bounds do not extend to the positive-rank POINTER/ALLOCATABLE branch, and scalar rank zero is not an assumed-shape array. Do not infer shape, extent, physical descriptor layout or allocation from the declaration.
